statement: Across every surname stem and every father's forename, the Great Berkhamsted baptism corpus contains no Mary Gurney at any date between 1544 and 1888; the only Mary Gurney in the parish is a burial of 1730. Mary Gurney married Daniel Shed at Braintree, Massachusetts in 1647 and was therefore born by 1631 at the latest, which is the one primary bound in the colonial child set. This is the single strongest objection to the younger Berkhamsted John, and it operates at parish level rather than at household level, so it cannot be explained by a mis-assigned father.
